paragraphs: Rabbi Shmuel ben Chalaf or Chalafta.

In Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot, chapter 3, at the end of halakhah 5: “Rabbi Yirmiyah; Rabbi Shmuel ben Chalafta, in the name of R' Ada bar Achvah.” At the beginning of Megillah chapter 3 the reading is ben Chalaf.

notes.text: The source juxtaposes Yirmiyah and Shmuel without an explicit link. The translation leaves that intermediate reporting relationship unresolved.

The saved whole Guggenheimer Berakhot3:5 scalar has full Rabbi Yirmiyah and Rabbi Shmuel bar Chalafta in [Rav] Ada bar Achvah’s name. It locates the passage missed by an exact בן search, while Hyman’s ben remains distinct from named bar. The whole Warsaw1863 Tosafot HaRosh24b:3 scalar quotes Yirmiyah and Shmuel as joint speakers; that is a different explicit presentation, not proof that the unconnected base chain has only one reading. Ada’s Rav is bracketed editorial supplementation in the named scalar, so supplied abbreviated R' Ada is not silently expanded to Rabbi or Rav. The Megillah Chalaf variant is not newly inspected or harmonized.

The consulted Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 3:1 has Rabbi Shmuel bar Chalaf and explicitly names Rav Ada bar Achvah. The corresponding Berakhot passage reads bar Chalafta and brackets Ada’s title. Hyman prints ben in his notice and preserves a compressed transmission. Tosafot HaRosh explicitly names Yirmiyah and Shmuel as joint speakers in its quotation.
